author: Andrew Fisher
finding: The legacy practice harness has a capability race, not a false Saved result. A previously initiated view-level version response can arrive after the test forces local edit flags. The Save adapter correctly refuses to capture an edit when SYNC.readonly is true.
testCorrection: The diagnostic can supply a consistent isolated edit capability from initial navigation via STABLE_EDIT=1 while holding native version 6052. All original Save assertions are retained; eight additional capability-gate assertions are included. Native document setters remain captured promises, and the harness rejects operational network writes. No application source change was needed.

coverage: typed draft remains unsaved with no document mutation
exact acknowledgement required for shared Saved
repeated Save does not replay field mutation
Reload preserves native value and reading position
no duplicate Save in specialized forms
